policy.purpose: Point 6 acceptance: natural-language association intent -> typed endpoint selectors -> read-only AssociationGoal -> AssociationCoordinator -> non-proof AgentContext projection.
invariants: Association intent is a bounded semantic decision over parser-supplied endpoint candidates, not a marker-word dictionary lookup.
The semantic probe receives no canonical AH UIDs and returns only ORDINARY, UNKNOWN, or one enumerated ASSOCIATION:Ea:Eb pair.
The association protocol probe runs with thinking disabled.
A composed actant exposes independently addressable member selectors without flattening the parser structure.
Only AssociationActRelationCandidate may carry the runtime ASSOCIATION relation id.
GoalCompiler does not create M, N, T, G, K, S, or L while resolving endpoints.
Existing entity endpoints resolve to canonical M; local proposition/formula endpoints resolve to already integrated N/G.
When no M exists, only a unique already indexed lexical S may be used as a fallback origin.
Entity ambiguity, lexical homography, unresolved handles, missing local proposition refs, and noncanonical formula expressions fail closed.
Parser endpoint selectors are distinct, but both may resolve to the same excitable canonical ref; L is never a valid origin.
AssociationGoal is executed by AssociationCoordinator and never wrapped in InferenceQuery for InferenceEngine.
Association search may converge on S/M/T/N/G/K according to ordinary AH activation/incidence mechanics.
AssociationOutcome is projected through AgentContext.association_blocks with ProjectionMode.ASSOCIATION, never through inference_blocks.
FOUND means representation convergence, not entailment and not a new asserted fact.
An ASSOCIATION runtime marker is never materialized as canonical L.
